English: In this chapter, we assess how much research in South Africa has been directed towards biological invasions relative to other elements of global change.
Luganda: Mu ssuula eno, twetegereza obungi bw’okunoonyereza mu South Afrika okukoleddwa ku kulumbibwa kw’ebitonde bw’ogeraageranya n’enkyukakyuka endala mu nsi.
Yoruba: Nínú abala yìí, a ní àǹfàní sí iye ìwádìí tí wọ́n ti ṣe ní South Africa tí wọ́n sì ti dojú rẹ̀ kọ àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí tí wọ́n ṣàfihàn wọn sí agbègbè tuntun tí wọ́n si ní ìbátan sí àwọn èrònjà mìíràn ti ìyípadà lágbàáyé.
Zulu: Kulesi sahluko, sihlola ukuthi lungakanani ucwaningo eNingizimu Afrika oluqondiswe ekuhlaselweni kwezinto eziphilayo uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izici zoshintsho emhlabeni.
Hausa: A wannan babi, mun tantance yawan bincike a Afirka ta Kudu da aka yi a kan mamayewar halittu dangane da sauran abubuwan da suke faruwa na sauyin duniya.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo kgaolong ye, re sekaseka ka gore ke dinyakišišo tše kaakang tšeo di dirilwego ka Afrika Borwa tšeo di bego di lebišitšwe go go šwahlela ga diphedi tša tlhago ge go bapetšwa le dikarlo tše dingwe tša phetogo ya lefaseng ka bophara.
Amharic: በዚህ ምዕራፍ በደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ ምን ያህል ምርምሮች ከሌሎች የዓለም አቀፍ ለውጥ አካላት አንፃር ባዮሎጂያዊ ወረራዎች ላይ ተመርኩዘው እንደነበረ እንገመግማለን።

English: Using Web of Science, we systematically reviewed literature relevant to South African ecosystems published between 2000 and 2018 and relating to biological invasions, climate change, overharvesting, habitat change, pollution, and/or atmospheric CO2.
Luganda: Nga tukozesa Web of Science, twekenneenya ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku butonde bw’ensi mu South Africa ebyafulumizibwa wakati wa 2000 ne 2018 era nga bikwata ku kulumbibwa kw’ebitonde, enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde, okukungula ekisusse, enkyukakyuka y’amaka g’ebisolo, okwonoona obutonde bw’ensi, ne/oba CO2 ow’omu bbanga.
Yoruba: Nípa lílo Wẹ́ẹ̀bù ìmọ̀ sáyẹ̀nsì, a lo ọgbọ́n láti ṣàtúnyẹ̀wò lítíréṣọ̀ tí ó ní ìjọra sí àwọn agbègbè ohun abẹ̀mí ní South Africa tí wọ́n tẹ̀ jáde láàárín 2000 àti 2018 tí ó sì ní ìbátan sí ṣíṣàfihàn àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí sí agbègbè tuntun, ìyípadà ojú ọjọ́, kíkó èrè oko ju bó ti yẹ lọ, ìyípadà agbègbè, ìbafẹ́fẹ́jẹ́, tàbí atimosifẹ́rìkì CO2.
Zulu: Sisebenzisa iWebhu Yesayensi, sibuyekeze ngokuhlelekile izincwadi ezihambisana nemvelo yaseNingizimu Afrika ezishicilelwe phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 kanye neziphathelene nokuhlasela kwebhayoloji, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, ukuvunwa ngokweqile, ukuguquka kwendawo yokuhlala, ukungcoliswa komhlaba, kanye/noma i-CO2 yomoya.
Hausa: Ta yin Web of Scienc, mun yi bita a kan wallafe-wallafen da suka dace da yanayin muhallin halitta na Afirka ta Kudu da aka buga a stsakanin shekarar 2000 zuwa shekarar 2018 da kuma abubuwan da suka shafi mamayewar halittu da sauyin yanayi da yawan girbi da sauyin wurin zama da gurɓacewar yanayi, da kuma/ko yanayi na CO2.
Northern Sotho: Ka go šomiša Wepsaete ya tša Mahlale, re ile ra lekodišiša dingwalwa ka tsinkelo tše id lego mabapi le diphedišano ya diphedi ka Afrika Borwa yeo e gatišitšwego magareng ga ngwaga wa 2000 le wa 2018 le mabapi le go šwahlela ga diphedi tša tlhago, phetogo ya tlelaemete, go buna diphedi go fetišiša, phetogo ya madulo, tšhilafatšo, le/goba CO2 ya lefaufaung.
Amharic: የሳይንስን ድረ-ገጽ በመጠቀም በ2000 እና በ2018 መካከል የታተሙትን እና ከባዮሎጂያዊ ወረራዎች፣ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ፣ ከመጠን በላይ ምርት መሰብሰብን፣ የመኖሪያ አካባቢ ለውጥን፣ ብክለትን እና/ወይም የከባቢ አየር CO2ን የሚመለከቱ ከደቡብ አፍሪካ ስነ-ምህዳር ጋር ተዛማጅነት ያላቸውን ጽሑፎች ስልታዊ በሆነ መልኩ ገምግመናል።

English: We identified 1149 relevant papers that were scored in terms of their coverage of drivers and driver interactions that affect biodiversity or ecosystem services.
Luganda: Twazuula empapula 1149 ez’omugaso ezaaweebwa obubonero okusinziira ku ebyo bye zoogerako ebikwata ku nkolagana ezireetawo enjawukana mu bitonde n’obutonde bw’ensi.
Yoruba: A ṣàfihàn àwọn ìwé 1149 tó ṣe pàtàkì tí wọ́n sì gbà wọlé nípa ìgboyà àwọn ohun tó ń ṣe àyípadà àti ìbáṣepọ̀ àwọn ohun tó ń ṣe àyípadà tí ó ní ipa lóri oníruúrú ohun àbẹmì lágbàáyé tàbi àwọn ètò lágbègbè àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí.
Zulu: Sihlonze amaphepha afanelekile ayi-1149 anikezwe amaphuzu ngokuya ngekhava yawo yabashayeli nokusebenzisana kwabashayeli okuthinta izinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo noma izinsiza ze-ecosystem.
Hausa: Mun gano takardun da suka dace guda 1149 waɗanda aka ƙididdige su dangane da ɗaukar nauyin masu haifar da hulɗoɗin sarrafawa waɗanda suke shafar bambancin halittu ko ayyuka na muhallin halitta.
Northern Sotho: Re ile ra hlatha dipampiri tša maleba tše 1149 tšeo di ilego tša fiwa dintlha mabapi le go akaretša ga tšona ga dihlohleletši le go rerišana le dihlohleletši tšeo di amago phapano ya diphedi goba ditirelo tša phedišano ya diphedi.
Amharic: የብዝሃ ህይወትን ወይም የስነ-ምህዳር አገልግሎቶችን የሚነኩ ከነጂዎች ሽፋን እና ከነጂዎች መስተጋብር አንፃር ነጥብ የተሰጣቸውን 1149 ተዛማጅ ወረቀቶችን አግኝተናል።

English: A strong spatio-temporal effect was observed on research effort.
Luganda: Ebireetebwa ekiseera n’ekifo ku kaweefube w’okunoonyereza byasangibwa nga bingi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àkíyèsí ipa ààyè àti àkókò tó lágbára lóri ìwádìí ìgbìyànjú.
Zulu: Umphumela oqinile we-spatio-temporal wabonwa emzamweni wocwaningo.
Hausa: An lura da tasiri mai ƙarfi na sifashiyo-temforal a kan ƙoƙarin bincike.
Northern Sotho: Seabe se maatla sa sekgoba le nako se ile sa lemogwa ka maitapišong a dinyakišišo.
Amharic: በምርምር ጥረት ላይ ጠንካራ የቦታ-ጊዜያዊ ተጽእኖ ተስተውሏል።

English: Firstly, effort differed between realms, with habitat change, pollution and overharvesting receiving the largest research focus within terrestrial, freshwater and marine/estuarine realms respectively.
Luganda: Okusooka, kaweefube yali ayawuka wakati w’ebisaawe, ng’enkyukakyuka y’amaka g’ebitonde, okwonoona obutonde n’okukungula ekiyitiridde bye byasinga okussibwako essira ly’okunoonyereza mu bisaawe by’oku lukalu, mu nnyanja, agayanja, mu busengeke obwo.
Yoruba: Lákọ̀ọ́kọ́, ipa yàtọ̀ sí ra láàárín àwọn ibùgbé, pẹ̀lú àyípadà lágbègbè, ìbafẹ́fẹ́jẹ́ àti kíkó èrè oko ju bó ti yẹ lọ, ní wọn gba ìfojúsùn ìwádìí tó tóbi jùlọ láàárín àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí tó ń gbé orí ilẹ̀, omi itọ́ àti àwọn ibùgbé nínú omi odò.
Zulu: Okokuqala, imizamo yahluka phakathi kwezindawo, lapho ukuguquka kwendawo yokuhlala, ukungcoliswa komhlaba kanye nokuvuna ngokweqile kwathola ucwaningo olugxile kakhulu endaweni esemhlabeni, emanzini ahlanzekile kanye nasolwandle/nezindawo zemifula ngokulandelana.
Hausa: Da farko dai, ƙoƙarin ya bambanta a tsakanin wurare, tare da sauyin wurin zama da gurɓacewar yanayi da yawan girbi suna karɓar mafi girman mayar da hankali kan bincike a cikin ƙasa da ruwa mai daɗi da wuraren ruwa/gaɓa bi-da-bi.
Northern Sotho: Sa mathomo, maitapišo a ile a fapana magareng ga seemo, fao go nago le phetogo ya madulo, tšhilafatšo le go buna diphedi go fetišiša fao go hwetšago nepišo ye kgolokgolo ya dinyakišišo ka lefelong le itšego, mafelo a diphedi tša ka meetseng a fioreše le tša lewatle/tša melomong ya dinaka.
Amharic: በመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ጥረቱ እንደየቦታው ይለያያል፤ የመኖሪያ አካባቢ ለውጥ፣ ብክለት እና ከመጠን በላይ ምርትን መሰብሰብ በቅደም ተከተል በየብስ፣ በጨው አልባ ውሃ እና ባህራማ/ሞገዳፍ ቦታዎች ትልቁን የምርምር ትኩረት አግኝተዋል።

English: Secondly, certain globally well-studied phenomena were not documented in local literature (e.g. there were fewer than five papers on ocean acidification).
Luganda: Ekyokubiri, ebintu ebimu ebinoonyerezebbwako obulungi mu nsi yonna byali tebiwandiikiddwako mu biwandiiko by’awaka (okugeza, empapula ezaali zoogera ku asidi w’omu gayanja zaali teziwera ttaano).
Yoruba: Ẹlẹ́ẹ̀kejì, dájúdájú àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tí wọ́n ṣe ìwádìí wọn kárí àgbáyé, wọ́n ko ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ wọn sínu lítíréṣọ̀ agbègbè (fún àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn ìwé tí kò ju márùn-ún lọ ló wà lóri ásììdì omi òkun).
Zulu: Okwesibili, izigigaba ezithile ezifundwe kahle emhlabeni wonke azibhalwanga ezincwadini zendawo (isb., bekunamaphepha angaphansi kwamahlanu e-acidification olwandle).
Hausa: Na biyu, ba a rubuta wasu bincike masu kyau a duniya ba a cikin ayyuka na gida ba (alal misali akwai ƙasa da takardu guda biyar a kan yadda ruwan teku yake zama acid).
Northern Sotho: Sa bobedi, tiragalo ye nngwe yeo e nyakišišitšwego lefaseng ka bophara ga se ya ngwalwa ka dingwalweng tša ka nageng (go fa mohlala, go bile le dipampiri tša ka fase ga tše hlano ka ga go tsena ga esiti ka mawatleng).
Amharic: በሁለተኛ ደረጃ አንዳንድ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በደንብ የተጠኑ ክስተቶች በአካባቢያዊ ስነ-ጽሑፍ ውስጥ አልተመዘገቡም (ለምሳሌ በውቅያኖስ አሲዳማነት ላይ ከአምስት ያነሱ ወረቀቶች ነበሩ)።

English: We identified 21 different interactions between drivers, with the interactions between invasive species and habitat change (for example altered fire regimes in invaded landscapes) being the most prominent.
Luganda: Twazuula enkolagana 21 wakati w’ensonga ez’enjawulo, ng’enkolagana wakati w’ebitonde ebirumbaganyi n’enkyukakyuka mu maka g’ebitonde (okugeza okukyuka kw’omuliro mu bifo ebirumbiddwa) bye byasinga okulabibwa.
Yoruba: A ṣàfihàn oríṣiríṣi ìbániṣepọ̀ tó tó 21 láàárín àwọn ohun tó ń ṣe àyípadà, pẹ̀lú ìbániṣepọ̀ láàárín àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí tó wà láti agbẹ̀gbẹ̀ mìíràn àti àyípadà ibùgbé (fún àpẹẹrẹ ìyípadà lásìkò iná àwọn ààlà ilẹ̀ tí wọ́n kógun jà) tó sì jẹ́ èyí tó gbajúmọ̀ jùlọ.
Zulu: Sihlonze ukusebenzisana okuhlukene okungu-21 phakathi kwabashayeli, nokusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezihlaselayo nokushintsha kwendawo (ngokwesibonelo imithetho eguquliwe yomlilo ezindaweni ezihlaselwe) okugqama kakhulu.
Hausa: Mun gano ma’amaloli daban-daban guda 21 a tsakanin masu haifarwa, tare da hulɗar a tsakanin nau’o’i masu mamayewa da sauyin wurin zama (alal misali sauyin tsarin kashe gobara a cikin wuraren da aka mamaye) shi ne mafi shahara.
Northern Sotho: Re ile ra hlatha dikamano tše 21 tše di fapanego tša dihlohleletši, fao go bilego le dikamano magareng ga mehuta ya diphedi tša go šwahlela le phetogo ya madulo (go fa mohlala dinako tša mello tše di fetošitšwego ka mafelong ao a šwahletšwego) e lego seo se tletšego kudu.
Amharic: በወረራ ዝርያዎች እና በመኖሪያ አካባቢ ለውጥ መካከል ያሉት መስተጋብሮች (ለምሳሌ በተወረሩ የመሬት ገጽታዎች ላይ የተለወጡ የእሳት አደጋዎች) በጣም የጎሉ ሆነው ሳሉ በነጂዎች መካከል 21 የተለያዩ መስተጋብሮችን ለይተናል።

English: However, fewer than 4% of papers addressed interactions between three or more drivers.
Luganda: Wabula, empapula ezitawera bitundu 4% ze zaali zikwata ku nkolagana wakati w’ensonga endala ssatu.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, díẹ̀ nínú ìdá 4% àwọn ìwé ló ṣàfihàn àwọn ìbáṣepọ̀ tó wà láàárín àwọn mẹ́ta tàbí jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ̀ àwọn ohun tó ń ṣe àyípadà.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, angaphansi kuka-4% wamaphepha akhulume ngokusebenzisana phakathi kwabashayeli abathathu noma ngaphezulu.
Hausa: Ko ta yaya, ƙasa da kashi 4% na takardun sun yi magana a kan hulɗoɗi a tsakanin masu haifarwa guda uku ko fiye.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, dipampiri tša ka fase ga 4% di ile tša bolela ka ga dikamano magareng ga dihlohleletši tše pedi goba go feta.
Amharic: ሆኖም ከ4% ያነሱ ወረቀቶች በሶስት ወይም ከዚያ በላይ በሆኑ ነጂዎች መካከል ያሉትን መስተጋብሮች ተመልክተዋል።

English: This suggests that while the importance of understanding driver interactions is recognised, there has been little in the way of researching the compound effects of driver interactions in South African ecosystems.
Luganda: Kino kitegeeza nti newankubadde ng’omugaso gw’okutegeera enkolagana y’ensonga gumanyiddwa, okunoonyereza kutono okubaddewo ku biva ku nkolagana y’ensonga mu butonde bw’ensi mu South Africa.
Yoruba: Èyí dába pé nígbà tí a ti mọ bí àǹfàní níní òye bí ìbániṣepọ̀ àwọn ohun tó ń ṣe àyípadà ṣe rí s, àwọn ọ̀nà díẹ̀ ti wà láti ṣe ìwádìí àwọn ipa ìbániṣepọ̀ àwọn ohun tó ń ṣe àyípadà ní agbègbè àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí ní South Africa.
Zulu: Lokhu kuphakamisa ukuthi nakuba ukubaluleka kokuqonda ukusebenzisana kwabashayeli kuqashelwa, kube nencane indlela yokucwaninga imithelela ehlanganisiwe yokusebenzelana kwabashayeli ezindaweni eziphilayo zaseNingizimu Afrika.

Northern Sotho: Ka go kgaolo ya puku ye e sa tšwago go ngwalwa, banyakišiši ba ile ba lebelela gore gabotse ke mošomo o mokaakang wa dinyakišišo ka Afrika Borwa ka ga go šwahlega ga dilo tša tlhago, e lego ge diphedi tša go swana le dimela goba diphoofolo di tlišwago lefelong le leswa bao di phelago gabotse gona, di tlwaelago gona ebile go nago le kgonagalo ya go kweša bohloko diphedi tše dingwe tša tikologong goba tikologo ka boyona.
Amharic: በቅርቡ በወጣው አንድ መጽሐፍ ምዕራፍ ውስጥ ተመራማሪዎች በደቡብ አፍሪካ በባዮሎጂያዊ ወረራዎች ላይ በትክክል ምን ያህል ምርምር እየተደረገ እንዳለ ተመልክተዋል፤ ይህም እንደ ዕፅዋት ወይም እንስሳት ያሉ ዝርያዎች ወደሚጎለብቱበት፣ ስር ወደሚሰዱበት እና ሌሎች በአካባቢው ያሉትን ዝርያዎች እና አካባቢውን ሊጎዱ ወደሚችሉበት አዲስ አካባቢ ሲገቡ ማለት ነው።

English: They also looked at research on how this driver interacts with other drivers.
Luganda: Era baatunuulira okunoonyereza okukwata ku ngeri ensonga eno gy’ekolaganamu n’ensonga endala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún wo ìwádìí lori bi àwọn ohun tó ń ṣe àyípadà yìí ṣe má ń ṣe pọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn tó kù tó ń ṣe àyípadà náà.
Zulu: Baphinde babheka ucwaningo lokuthi lo mshayeli uxhumana kanjani nabanye abashayeli.
Hausa: Sun kuma duba bincike a kan yadda wannan mai sarrafawar yake hulɗa da sauran masu haifarwa.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lebelela gape dinyakišiši mabapi le ka fao sehlohleletši se se dirišanago le dihlohleletši tše dingwe.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ይህ ነጂ ከሌሎች ነጂዎች ጋር ስላለው መስተጋብር ምርምር ተመልክተዋል።

English: Looking through research papers published between 2000 and 2018 on the “Web of Science” database, they found 1149 relevant studies.
Luganda: Nga batunuulira empapula z’okunoonyereza ezaafulumizibwa wakati wa 2000 ne 2018 mu tterekero lya “Web of Science”, baazuula okunoonyereza okw’omugaso kwa mirundi 1149.
Yoruba: Wíwo àwọn ìwé ìwádìí tí wọ́n tẹ̀ jáde láàárín 2000 ati 2018 lóri “Wẹ́ẹ̀bù ìpadátàmọ́ ti ìmọ̀ sáyẹ̀nsì”, wọ́n ri àwọn 1149 ìwádìí tó jọmọ.
Zulu: Bebheka emaphepheni ocwaningo ashicilelwe phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 kusizindalwazi se-"Web of Science", bathola izifundo ezifanele eziyi-1149.
Hausa: Duba ta cikin takardun bincike da aka buga a tsakanin shekarar 2000 da kuma shekarar 2018 a kan rumbun bayanan "Web of Science", sun sami bincike da suka dace guda 1149.
Northern Sotho: Go lebelela ka go dimpampiri tša dinyakišišo tše di gatišitšwego magareng ga ngwaga wa 2000 le 2018 go bobolokelo bja tshedimošo bja “Web of Science”, gomme ba hwetša dinyakišišo tša maleba tše 1149.
Amharic: በ2000 እና 2018 መካከል በ”ሳይንስ ድረ-ገጽ” መረጃ ቋት ላይ የታተሙ የምርምር ወረቀቶችን በመመልከት 1149 ተዛማጅ ጥናቶችን አግኝተዋል።

English: Their review of the studies showed that land-based (terrestrial) research focussed more on changes in habitat, while freshwater research centred on pollution, and marine and estuary research looked mostly at overharvesting.
Luganda: Okwekenneenya kwabwe okw’okunoonyereza kwalaga nti okunoonyereza okw’oku lukalu kwasinga kukwata ku nkyukakyuka mu maka g’ebitonde, so ng’okw’amazzi g’ennyanja kwali kukwata ku kwonoona mazzi, ate okw’amazzi g’agayanja n’emigga kwasinga kutunuulira kuvuba okususse.
Yoruba: Àtúnyẹ̀wò wọn lóri àwọn ìwádìí yìí fi hàn pé ìwádìí tó dá lóri ilẹ̀ (àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí tó ń gbé orí ilẹ̀) ní ọ̀pọ̀ àfojúsùn lóri àwọn àyípadà ibùgbé, tí ìwádìí lóri omi itọ́ dá lóri ìbafẹ́fẹ́jẹ́, tí ìwádìí omi odò ńlá wo kíkó èrè oko jú bó ti yẹ lọ.
Zulu: Ukubuyekezwa kwabo kocwaningo kubonise ukuthi umhlabathi (i-terrestrial) ) ucwaningo lwalugxile kakhulu ezinguqukweni zendawo yokuhlala, kuyilapho ucwaningo lwamanzi ahlanzekile lugxile ekungcolisweni, futhi ucwaningo lwasolwandle nechweba lubheke kakhulu ukuvuna ngokweqile.
Hausa: Bitarsu ta binciken ta nuna cewa bincike na tushen ƙasa (na ƙasa) ya fi mayar da hankali ne a kan sauye-sauye a wuraren zama, a yayin da bincike na ruwa mai tsabta ya shafi gurbatawa, kuma bincike na ruwa da jikin ruwa ya dubi mafi yawa a kan yawan girbi.
Northern Sotho: Tekodišišo ye ya dinyakišišo e laeditše gore dinyakišišo tša nageng (tša lefelong) di lebeletše kudu go diphetogo tša madulo, mola e le gore dinyakišišo ka ga meetse a foreše di theilwe go tšhilafatšo, le go dinyakišišo tša mawatle le tša melomo ya dinoka gomme tšona di lebeletše kudu go buna go fetišiša.
Amharic: የጥናቶቹ ግምገማ እንደሚያሳየው በመሬት ላይ የተመሠረተ (የብሳዊ) ምርምር በመኖሪያ አካባቢ ለውጦች ላይ ያተኮረ እንደሆነ እና የጨው አልባ ውሃ ጥናት ደግሞ ብክለትን ያማከለ ሲሆን የባህር እና የሞገዳፍ ምርምር ደግሞ በአብዛኛው ከመጠን በላይ ምርት መሰብሰብን ይመለከታል።

English: They also found that phenomena that are well-documented globally to affect biodiversity or ecosystem services, are not well-documented in local South African studies.
Luganda: Era baakizuula nti ensonga eziwandiikiddwako obulungi mu nsi yonna nti zikosa obutonde bw’ensi, teziwandiikiddwako bulungi mu kunoonyereza kw’e South Africa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ri pé àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tí wọ́n ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ tó dára fún kárí ayé ní ipa tó ń kó lóri oníruúrú ohun àbẹmì lágbàáyé tàbi àwọn ètò lágbègbè àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí, wọ́n sì tún rí àwọn ìwádìí tí wọn kò ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ tó dára fún ní agbègbè South Africa.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi izenzakalo ezibhalwe kahle emhlabeni wonke ezithinta ukuhlukahluka kwemvelo noma izinsiza ze-ecosystem, azibhalwanga kahle izifundo zaseNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Har wa yau, sun gano cewa al’amuran da aka rubuta su da kyau a duniya don shafar bambancin halittu ko ayyukan muhalli, ba su da cikakkun rubuce-rubuce a cikin binciken gida na Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba utolla gape gore ditiragalo tše go ngwadilwego ka tšona kudu lefaseng ka bophara tšeo di amago mehutahuta ya diphedi goba ditirelo tša phedišano ya diphedi, ga se gwa ngwalwa kudu ka ga tšona ka go dinyakišišo tša ka Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: በብዝሃ ህይወት ወይም በስነ-ምህዳር አገልግሎቶች ላይ ተጽእኖ በማሳደር በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በደንብ የተመዘገቡ ክስተቶች በአካባቢው በደቡብ አፍሪካ ጥናቶች በደንብ ያልተመዘገቡ መሆናቸውንም ደርሰውበታል።

English: For example, they only found 5 papers looking at ocean acidification, which disrupts food chains and harms sea life.
Luganda: Okugeza, baazuula empapula 5 zokka ezitunuulira asidi mu gayanja, ng’ono ataataaganya entambula y’emmere era n’akosa obulamu bw’ebitonde by’omu gayanja.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, wọ́n ṣàwárí àwọn ìwé 5 tí ó ń wo ásììdì òkun, tí ó ń ṣe ìdíwọ́ fún títà àti rírà oúnjẹ tí ó sì má ń ṣe ìpalára sí ìgbé ayé omi òkun.
Zulu: Isibonelo, bathole amaphepha angu-5 kuphela abheka i-acidification yolwandle, ephazamisa amaketanga okudla futhi elimaza impilo yasolwandle.
Hausa: Alal misali, kawai sun sami takardu 5 ne suka kalli yadda ruwan teku yake zama acid, wanda yake katse samar dar abinci da kuma cutar da rayuwar teku.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, ba hweditše fela dipampiri tše 5 tšeo di bego di lebeletše go tsenya esiti ka mawatleng, e lego seo se šitišago lenaneo la dijo ka lewatleng le go bolayta diphedi tša ka lewatleng.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ የምግብ ሰንሰለትን የሚረብሽ እና የባህር ህይወትን የሚጎዳ የውቅያኖስ አሲዳማነትን የሚመለከቱ 5 ወረቀቶችን ብቻ አግኝተው ነበር።

English: This happens because excess carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, from human activities like burning fossil fuels, dissolves in seawater.
Luganda: Kino kibaawo kubanga omukka gwa kaboni ogususse mu bbanga, nga guva mu bikolebwa abantu ng’okwokya amafuta, guggweererera mu mazzi g'agayanja.
Yoruba: Èyí ṣẹlẹ̀ látàrí pípọ̀jù èémí ìmísóde sí afẹ́fẹ́, láti inú ohun tí àwọn ènìyàn ṣe bíi jíjó nǹkan, àwọn epo fósàìlì, àti àwọn ohun tó ń toró sínú omi òkun.
Zulu: Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba i-carbon dioxide eningi emkhathini, evela emisebenzini yabantu efana nokushiswa kwezinto ezimbiwa phansi, incibilika emanzini olwandle.
Hausa: Wannan yana faruwa ne saboda wuce gona da iri na baƙin hayaƙi a cikin yanayi, daga ayyukan ɗan’adam kamar ƙonewar ɓurɓushin mai da narkewa a cikin ruwan teku.
Northern Sotho: Se se direga ka gobane khaponetaeoksaete ye ntši ka lefaufaung, ye e bakilwego ke ditiro tša batho ge ba tšhuma dibešwa, e tologela ka gare ga meetse a lewatle.
Amharic: ይህ የሆነበት ምክንያት በከባቢ አየር ውስጥ ያለው ትርፍ ካርቦን ዳይኦክሳይድ እንደ ቅሪተ አካል ነዳጆችን ማንደድ ከመሳሰሉ የሰዎች ተግባራት የተነሳ የባህር ውሃ ውስጥ ስለሚሟሟ ነው።

English: Habitat changes, such as fires or climate changes, lead to the growth of invasive species.
Luganda: Enkyukakyuka mu maka g’ebitonde, okugeza omuliro oba enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde, biviirako okweyongera kw’ebitonde ebirumbaganyi.
Yoruba: Àwọn àyípadà ibùgbé àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí, bíi iná tàbí àyípadà ojú ọjọ́, tí ó já sí ìdàgbàsókè àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí tí kọ̀ kí ń ṣe ará agbègbè kan.
Zulu: Izinguquko zezindawo zokuhlala, ezifana nemililo noma ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ziholela ekukhuleni kwezinhlobo zezilwane ezihlaselayo.
Hausa: Canjin yanayi, kamar gobara ko sauyin yanayi, yana haifar da bunƙasar nau'i masu ɓarna.
Northern Sotho: Diphetogo tša madulo, tša go swana le tše di bakago ke mello goba diphetogo tša tlelaemete, di feletša ka kgolo ya mehuta ya diphedi tša go šwahlela.
Amharic: እንደ እሳት ወይም የአየር ንብረት ለውጦች የመሳሰሉ የመኖሪያ አካባቢ ለውጦች ወደ ወራሪ ዝርያዎች እድገት ያመራሉ።

English: They said that carbon dioxide has increased by around 40%, and it could be creating better conditions for alien plants to grow in.
Luganda: Baagamba nti omukka gwa kaboni gweyongedde ebitundu nga 40%, era nga kiyinza okuba nga embeera ennungi eri ebirime ebigwira okukuliramu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ wí pé èémí ìmísóde ti lọ sókè pẹ̀lú ìdá 40%, tí ó sì lè pèsè ipò tó dára fún ìdàgbàsókè àwọn irúgbìn tí kì í ṣe ará agbègbè kan.
Zulu: Bathe i-carbon dioxide inyuke cishe ngo-40%, futhi ingase idale izimo ezingcono zokuthi izitshalo zangaphandle zikhule kuzo.
Hausa: Sun ce baƙin hayaƙi ya ƙaru da kusan kashi 40%, kuma yana iya haifar da ingantattun yanayi don baƙin tsire-tsire su yi girma a ciki.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore khaponetaeoksaete e oketšegile ka palo ye e ka bago 40%, gomme e ka be e hlama maemo a makaone go dimela tše di sego tša setlogo gore di mele fao.
Amharic: ካርቦን ዳይኦክሳይድ በ40% ገደማ ጨምሯል እና ለባዕድ እፅዋት እድገት ምቹ ሁኔታዎችን እየፈጠረ ሊሆን ይችላል ብለዋል።

English: But, there is very little research done on this issue in South Africa.
Luganda: Naye, waliwo okunoonyereza kutono nnyo okukoleddwa ku nsonga eno mu South Africa.
Yoruba: Àmọ́, ìwádìí tí ò tó nǹkan wà tí wọ́n ṣe lóri ìṣòro yìí ní South Africa.
Zulu: Kodwa, luncane kakhulu ucwaningo olwenziwe mayelana nalolu daba eNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Amma, akwai bincike kaɗan da aka yi a kan wannan batu a Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Eupša, go dirilwe dinyakišišo tše mmalwa kudu ka ga taba ye ka Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: ነገር ግን በዚህ ጉዳይ ላይ በደቡብ አፍሪካ የተደረገ ምርምር በጣም ጥቂት ነው።

English: They found 21 papers looking at how different drivers interact.
Luganda: Baazuula empapula 21 ezikwata ku ngeri ensonga ez’enjawulo gye zikolaganamu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí àwọn ìwé 21 tí ó ń wó bí oríṣiríṣi àwọn ohun tó ń ṣe àyípadà ṣe má ń ṣe.
Zulu: Bathole amaphepha angu-21 abheka ukuthi abashayeli abahlukene basebenzisana kanjani.
Hausa: Sun sami takardu guda 21 da suka kalli yadda masu haifarwa daban-daban suke hulɗa.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše dipampiri tše 21 tšeo di bego di lebeletše ka fao dihlohleletši tše di fapafapanego di amanago ka gona.
Amharic: የተለያዩ ነጂዎች እንዴት እንደሚገናኙ የሚመለከቱ 21 ወረቀቶችን አግኝተዋል።

English: Most of these focussed on linking habitat changes and invasive species.
Luganda: Ezisinga ku zino zaali zikwanaganya enkyukakyuka z’amaka g’ebitonde n’ebitonde ebirumbaganyi.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ èyí ní àfojúsùn lóri síso àyípadà ibùgbé àti àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí tí kọ̀ kí ń ṣe ará agbègbè kan pọ̀.
Zulu: Okuningi kwalokhu kugxile ekuxhumaniseni izinguquko zendawo yokuhlala kanye nezinhlobo ezihlaselayo.
Hausa: Yawancin waɗannan sun mayar da hankali a kan haɗa sauye-sauyen muhalli da nau’i masu ɓarna.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja tšona di nepišitše diphetogo tša madulo le mehuta ya diphedi tša go šwahlela.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ ውስጥ አብዛኛዎቹ ያተኮሩት የመኖሪያ አካባቢ ለውጦችን እና ወራሪ ዝርያዎችን በማገናኘት ላይ ነው።

English: But, very few papers looked at 3 or more drivers at the same time.
